title: ComNetX: Local Hierarchical Adaptation for Dynamic Community Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.16906v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic community detection is commonly addressed either by full-snapshot recomputation or by solver-specific dynamic procedures. Full recomputation preserves the semantics of mature static solvers, but it repeatedly processes unchanged graph regions when updates are small. Solver-specific dynamic methods can reduce this cost, but their update rules often have limited transferability across objectives, feature representations, and implementations. In addition, localizing computation only by graph distance may omit community context needed by high-quality solvers. We introduce ComNetX, a solver-agnostic hierarchical adaptation framework for local dynamic updates. ComNetX maintains a multi-level community state, expands the updated region, closes it over affected communities, and contracts these communities into compact local instances. This affected-community closure and contraction preserve solver context while restricting computation

translated_title: ComNetX：面向动态社区检测的局部层次化自适应方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16906v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：动态社区检测通常通过全快照重计算或特定求解器的动态程序来处理。全重计算保持了成熟静态求解器的语义，但当更新较小时，它会反复处理未变化的图区域。特定求解器的动态方法可以减少这种成本，但其更新规则在目标、特征表示和实现之间的可移植性往往有限。此外，仅通过图距离局部化计算可能遗漏高质量求解器所需的社区上下文。我们引入了ComNetX，一种与求解器无关的层次化自适应框架，用于局部动态更新。ComNetX维护多级社区状态，扩展更新区域，在受影响的社区上闭合它，并将这些社区收缩为紧凑的局部实例。这种受影响社区闭合和收缩保留了求解器上下文，同时限制了计算范围。
tldr: ComNetX提出了一种与求解器无关的层次化局部更新框架，通过社区闭合与收缩保留上下文，从而在动态社区检测中实现高效且可移植的更新。
en_tdlr: ComNetX proposes a solver-agnostic hierarchical local update framework that preserves context via affected-community closure and contraction, enabling efficient and transferable dynamic community detection.
